newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: B.I.G. Industries 6-mth net 1.56 mln rgt.
newsitem.headline: B.I.G. Industries 6-mth net 1.56 mln rgt.

text.p: Malaysian industrial gases maker B.I.G. Industries Bhd said on Thursday that it had a net profit of 1.56 million ringgit for the six months ended June 30, 1996.
There were no comparative figures from a year ago, as the company, which went public last December, acquired its businesses on October 24, 1995.
On a per share basis, it earned 8.10 ringgit a share, the company said in a statement. B.I.G.'s stock was suspended on Thursday for its results.
Turnover for the six months was 15.69 million ringgit. On a pre-tax basis, consolidated operating profit was 2.22 million ringgit.
In its earnings statement, B.I.G. said the net profit before taxation for the six months is "within our expectation," and that it expected the second half results to be better.
It also said that barring unforeseen circumstances, it expects to achieve the projected profit stated in its prospectus for the year ending Dec. 31, 1996.
In its prospectus, B.I.G. had forecast a net profit of 4.23 million ringgit for this full year.
